sentences.text: Thornbill-NER meets the pre-specified robustness criterion at all tested noise rates, with mean test F1 dropping by at most 1.8 points (from 91.4% at 0% noise to 89.6% at 30% noise), whereas the Lindgren-Tagger baseline exceeds the 2.0-point threshold at every noise level, dropping by 2.6, 5.5, and 8.9 points at 10%, 20%, and 30% noise, respectively.

Under original labels, Thornbill-NER also shows a slightly smaller seed-to-seed range (0.9 points) than Lindgren-Tagger (1.2 points), though no statistical test was reported for this or any other comparison.
